intermediate_significant_gain.baseline: new candidate vs concurrent frozen B, eight primary queries

registered_intermediate_gates.rationale: Qualified medium all-node exclusive supply is 57.17%; even 2x supply gives only 1.40x end-to-end. A 1.5x all-node target thus requires more than merely halving this boundary, or additional work reductions outside it. Overall 1.5x prevents isolated-query wins being marketed as substantial. Holdout is an independent requirement, not predicted by the medium model.
stop_conditions: No callback or value replay after partial delivery; no relaxed authentication, snapshot, cancellation or budgets.
If deterministic counts show work moved rather than eliminated, retain failure and redesign before stage acceptance.
R4 misses any of the eight Kuzu P50 targets or has unresolved reproducible material P95 regression: no 100%.
If material performance, write, memory or space regressions are reproducible, fix them or apply only the adoption restrictions frozen before implementation; no post-hoc scope narrowing.
registered_intermediate_gates.limitations: Thresholds are objectives, not statistical proof or guaranteed achievable outcomes. Percentile instability requires review under the existing protocol; tail cause and internal supply breakdown remain unresolved.

slow_query_selected_work.limitations: Selected counts do not cover all work or CPU instructions; observer failed timing-quality gate, and sample timing cannot be used to estimate component shares.

kuzu_profile.note: Post-only profile outputs zero for the same predicate. Row reduction is observed; pruning implementation is unknown. Profile timings are not formal benchmark timings.

model.formula: 1 / (1-f+f/s), when only the measured exclusive supply boundary is changed
model.interpretation: Measured supply is the largest qualified boundary, not a demonstrated removable amount. Callback-only elimination is too small to reach the 1.5x intermediate gate. A qualifying candidate must reduce additional source and/or outside-source work.

candidate_hypotheses: Use snapshot-valid predicate pruning to skip provably nonmatching blocks and preserve exact fallback semantics.
Fuse scan, block authentication, typed columns and filtering to reduce repeated group/page work and per-cell materialization; verify actual work reductions, do not assume them.
For multi-key grouping, validate per-row PMR string-key allocations, then evaluate typed composite-key lookup with safe semantics and budgets.
carried_risks: A credible breakdown of the largest removable cost inside and outside the source boundary remains missing; both repeat observers failed preregistered gates.
The three slow queries repeat selected work counts, but uncounted instructions versus execution-speed changes are unresolved.
The allocation experiment validates real persisted read data only; updated-data lifecycle and complete block-path proof remain R1/R3 obligations.
